name: entrust-ai-apex
description: Certifies high-consequence writing against the material it rests on, or refuses it and names what must change.

interface.longDescription:
APEX examines a piece of writing against the material it is supposed to rest on, and either releases it with a signed certificate or withholds release and names what must change. It does not soften, it does not release on a close call, and it never rewrites a text it was asked to certify as it stands.

Give APEX the material — a record, a note, a document, a thread — and either your own finished text or a request for one. Independent examiners read it, a defect judge tries to reject it, a challenger builds the strongest rival version, and a final arbiter decides. A release carries an Ed25519 receipt binding the exact text, the exact case, and the exact run; anyone can check it at entrustai.co/verify without an account.

Write apex bold for a piece that takes and holds a position of its own: it leads with its own claim, disagrees openly where the source deserves it, and concedes nothing the source has not established. Only the stance changes. Facts, evidence, logic and length are examined exactly as in any request, and a bold claim the material does not support is refused.

Built for writing whose consequence is real: replies to regulators, donor letters, board notes, customer communications where an unsupported sentence is expensive.
defaultPrompt: apex certify this letter exactly as it stands, word for word.
apex write our reply to this customer complaint, using only what the attached ticket establishes.
apex bold a reply to this LinkedIn post, at most 1230 characters

positive.description: Certify the person's own letter word for word against the record it rests on. Every claim in the letter is supported by the record.
positive.prompt: apex certify this letter exactly as it stands. Letter: Dear Friend, Thank you for your tzedakah of $5,000, received on 3 September 2026. Your gift will be applied in full to the Beit Arizal publication fund, and a receipt for tax purposes will follow separately. With gratitude and warm blessings, Abraham Chachamovits. Record: Donor ledger entry: gift of $5,000 received on 3 September 2026, designated to the Beit Arizal publication fund. A tax receipt is issued separately for every gift.
positive.expected_behavior: APEX returns the letter unchanged, word for word, followed by an APEX CEILING certificate: receipt ID, artifact and case SHA-256, Ed25519 signature, signer fingerprint, and a link to check the receipt at entrustai.co/verify. Proven live 16 Oct 2026, receipt 20261016T120617Z-628ac7977558.

positive.description: Certify a letter word for word when one claim contradicts the record: the letter gives the gift as $50,000, the record as $5,000. APEX must refuse and name the claim.
positive.prompt: apex certify this letter exactly as it stands. Letter: Dear Friend, Thank you for your tzedakah of $5,000, received on 3 September 2026. Your gift of $50,000 will be applied in full to the Beit Arizal publication fund, and a receipt for tax purposes will follow separately. With gratitude and warm blessings, Abraham Chachamovits Record: Donor ledger entry: gift of $5,000 received on 3 September 2026, designated to the Beit Arizal publication fund. A tax receipt is issued separately for every gift
positive.expected_behavior: APEX NOT READY. The letter is neither released nor rewritten. The finding names the $50,000 amount as unsupported, since the record gives $5,000, followed by a What helps line and a signed refusal receipt. Proven live 16 Oct 2026, receipt 20261016T120927Z-f3ad608137b3.

positive.description: APEX writes a customer reply from a support ticket, within a 600-character limit, stating only what the ticket establishes, and certifies it.
positive.prompt: apex write our reply to this customer complaint, using only what the ticket establishes, at most 600 characters. Complaint: I was charged twice for my October subscription. Fix this now. Ticket: Account 4471. Duplicate charge of $29 on 2 October 2026 confirmed. Refund of $29 issued on 3 October 2026. Refunds reach the card within 5 to 10 business days.
positive.expected_behavior: A reply of at most 600 characters stating only the ticket's facts: the duplicate $29 charge on 2 October 2026, the $29 refund on 3 October 2026, and 5 to 10 business days to reach the card. APEX CEILING certificate follows. Proven live 1 Nov 2026, receipt 20261101T104644Z-a286a4454748.

positive.description: A request that rests on facts it does not supply: a team message claiming an outage was fixed for every client, with no record attached.
positive.prompt: apex a message to my team saying we fixed the outage for every client
positive.expected_behavior: APEX says it needs the facts the message rests on, such as figures, dates or events, and that the request did not go ahead and nothing was charged. It writes no message and invents no facts.

positive.description: The person sends only the word apex, to learn what APEX does.
positive.expected_behavior: The ENTRUST AI APEX overview card: what APEX does, how to ask (including apex bold), the steps of a run, what you receive, what a certification means, the receipt, the account and files. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

negative.description: An ordinary proofreading request without the word apex. ChatGPT should answer itself; APEX should not run.
negative.prompt: Can you check my email draft for typos? 'Hi Sam, see you tomorow at the office.'
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT corrects the typo itself. APEX is not called and no certificate appears.

negative.description: A request to write a short personal note, without the word apex. ChatGPT should write it itself; APEX should not run.
negative.prompt: Write a short thank-you note to my son's teacher for her help this term.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the note itself. APEX is not called and no certificate appears.

negative.description: A question close to what APEX does, whether a reply is ready to send, but without the word apex. ChatGPT should answer itself; APEX should not run.
negative.prompt: Is this reply to a customer ready to send? 'Your refund of $29 was issued on 3 October and should reach your card within 5 to 10 business days.'
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT answers itself. APEX is not called and no certificate appears.

review.commerce_description: APEX sells nothing and shows no prices inside ChatGPT. Each run uses a reply from the person's APEX account, which is managed at entrustai.co/app.

publication.release_notes: First release of ENTRUST AI APEX in ChatGPT. Write apex in your message, and APEX writes or checks high-consequence text against the material it rests on. It releases the text with a signed certificate that anyone can check at entrustai.co/verify, or withholds it and names what must change. Write apex bold for a piece that takes and holds a position of its own.
